gap_found_by_this_task: No test tied the palette to a save/reopen: the persistence of the lock/visibility flags and of the picked ids was unverified for this module.

Added the fixture-driven round trip: K1..K3 prove slots, flags, colours, object ids and the selectable policy survive a reopen; L1..L3 prove the palette never shows another document's slots, that a failed open changes nothing, and that an unsaved in-memory flag is not in the reopened file.

Finding worth recording: touching one preset slot creates its whole four-slot group (the controller's documented rule), so a document with Gems locked and Metals hidden stores slots 1..8, not just 1 and 5. The fixture says so instead of assuming two rows.
RED is API-level for the new fixture file; the round trip itself already worked, which is the honest result.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the 'the interface follows the document' rule; ADD the round-trip fixtures that hold it.
